in_marathi.name: Padminiyam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padminiyam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Padminiyam refers to the Goddess Lakshmi who is often depicted seated on a lotus flower.
